# Protocol

Methods, events and error codes of the agent protocol.

The JSON-RPC protocol between the agent host and its surfaces (TUI, desktop, dashboard, editors attached through the daemon). Protocol version: 1.

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`session.create`](#sessioncreate) | Create a session. |

### session.create

Create a session.

Parameters:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | str or null | no | A title for the session; absent leaves it untitled. |
| `cwd` | str or null | no | The working directory tools start in; absent uses the server's. |
| `model` | str or null | no | The model to use; absent uses the configured default. |
| `toolsets` | list[str] or null | no | Toolsets to enable; absent uses the surface's default selection. |
| `idempotency_key` | str or null | no | Repeating a create with the same key returns the first session instead of a new one. |

Result:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | str | yes | The session's id. |
| `created` | bool | yes | False when an earlier create with the same idempotency key is being returned. |

Errors: `PARSE_ERROR`, `INVALID_REQUEST`, `METHOD_NOT_FOUND`, `INVALID_PARAMS`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`, `UNKNOWN_PARAM_KEY`, `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`, `PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE`, `STORE_FAILED`, `POLICY_CONFLICT`.

### session.resume

Attach to an existing session.

Parameters:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | SessionId | yes | The session to resume. |

Result:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|

| `message_count` | int | yes | Number of stored messages. |

Errors: `PARSE_ERROR`, `INVALID_REQUEST`, `METHOD_NOT_FOUND`, `INVALID_PARAMS`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`, `UNKNOWN_PARAM_KEY`, `SESSION_NOT_FOUND`, `SESSION_REFUSED`, `STORE_FAILED`, `SESSION_BUSY`, `POLICY_CONFLICT`.

### prompt.submit

Send a user message and start a turn.

Parameters:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | SessionId | yes | The session to run the turn in. |
| `text` | MessageText | yes | The user's message. |
| `when_busy` | BusyAction | no | While a turn runs: refuse (``SESSION_BUSY``), queue it, steer or redirect the turn. |
| `request_id` | str or null | no | The client's id for this input (daemon): sending it again returns the first admission instead of running the text twice. |
| `unattended` | bool | no | A finite run nobody watches (``indus -z``; daemon): this input's turn auto-approves risky commands as the in-process run does (the hard floors still refuse). In-process hosts take the run's approval policy from its launch and ignore it. |

Result:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `turn_id` | str | yes | The turn's id; its events carry it. For a queued or steered message: the running turn. From the daemon: the input's admission id. |
| `generation` | int or null | no | The turn's generation, for interrupts. Left out only by the daemon for an input it has not claimed yet (``queued`` with no turn running): follow it by ``turn.started`` or ``admission.state``. |
| `status` | SubmitStatus | no | ``streaming`` when this message started the turn. |

Errors: `PARSE_ERROR`, `INVALID_REQUEST`, `METHOD_NOT_FOUND`, `INVALID_PARAMS`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`, `UNKNOWN_PARAM_KEY`, `SESSION_NOT_FOUND`, `SESSION_REFUSED`, `STORE_FAILED`, `TEXT_EMPTY`, `SESSION_BUSY`, `PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE`, `ADMISSION_CONFLICT`, `QUEUE_FULL`, `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`, `LEASE_LOST`.

### session.interrupt

Stop the running turn.

Parameters:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | SessionId | yes | The session whose turn to stop. |
| `generation` | int or null | no | Only interrupt this generation; a stale one makes the call a no-op. |
| `hard` | bool | no | Also drop queued steer text. |

Result:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `interrupted` | bool | yes | False when no turn (or no turn of that generation) was running. |

Errors: `PARSE_ERROR`, `INVALID_REQUEST`, `METHOD_NOT_FOUND`, `INVALID_PARAMS`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`, `UNKNOWN_PARAM_KEY`, `SESSION_NOT_FOUND`.

### session.steer

Add guidance the running turn picks up after its current step.

Parameters:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | SessionId | yes | The session with the running turn. |
| `text` | MessageText | yes | The guidance. |
| `generation` | int or null | no | The turn the guidance is for; the daemon requires it and ignores another turn's steer. |

Result:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `queued` | bool | yes | False when no turn is running; the client should send it as a new prompt. |
| `ticket` | str or null | no | Identifies the queued text so it can be withdrawn. |

Errors: `PARSE_ERROR`, `INVALID_REQUEST`, `METHOD_NOT_FOUND`, `INVALID_PARAMS`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`, `UNKNOWN_PARAM_KEY`, `SESSION_NOT_FOUND`, `TEXT_EMPTY`.

### command.dispatch

Resolve a command word that is not a client command.

Parameters:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | SessionId | yes | The session it acts on. |
| `name` | str | yes | The command word, with or without the slash. |
| `arg` | str | no | Everything after the word. |

Result:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | DispatchKind | yes | What to do next. |
| `output` | str or null | no | For ``exec``: the output to show. |

| `text` | str or null | no | ``rewind``: the text of the oldest user message taken back; ``command``: the reply. |
| `outcome` | str or null | no | ``compress``: ``compressed``, ``nothing``, ``blocked`` or ``aborted``. |
| `servers` | list[str] or null | no | ``editor_mcp`` / ``branch``: the editor servers whose tools the session has. |
| `refused_servers` | list[str] or null | no | ``editor_mcp``: servers whose spec differs from the one recorded for the session. |

## Notifications

| Method | What it carries |
|---|---|
| `gateway.ready` | The first frame of a connection (stdio or the daemon's WebSocket): the server is ready for |
| `session.replay_gap` | The events after this viewer's cursor cannot be sent; reload a snapshot of the session. |
| `session.updated` | A session changed in a way list views show (sent to ``sessions.watch`` watchers). |
| `sessions.resync` | List updates for this connection were dropped; reload the list (``session.list``). |
| `wake.detected` | ``wake.detected``: the phrase was heard; start voice capture now. |

## Events

| Event | What it means |
|---|---|
| [`turn.started`](#turnstarted) | A turn began running. |
| [`message.delta`](#messagedelta) | A piece of the assistant's visible reply. |
| [`reasoning.delta`](#reasoningdelta) | A piece of the model's reasoning, shown apart from the reply. |
| [`tool.started`](#toolstarted) | A tool call began. |
| [`tool.progress`](#toolprogress) | A running tool reported progress. |
| [`tool.completed`](#toolcompleted) | A tool call finished (successfully or not). |
| [`status`](#status) | The session's activity changed. |
| [`notice`](#notice) | A message for the user that is not part of the conversation. |
| [`server_request.cancelled`](#server_requestcancelled) | An open server request was withdrawn; clients close its prompt. |
| [`turn.done`](#turndone) | A turn ended. Sent exactly once per turn, after its last row is stored. |
| [`learning.review.done`](#learningreviewdone) | A background review of the conversation finished (memory and skills, P09-16). |
| [`goal.update`](#goalupdate) | The session's standing goal changed (set, judged, continued, paused, done, cleared). |
| [`loop.update`](#loopupdate) | One of the session's loops changed (set, ticked, finished, paused, stopped). |
| [`heartbeat.fired`](#heartbeatfired) | A heartbeat sent its recurring instruction into the session (shown as a "wake" row). |
| [`message.complete`](#messagecomplete) | A turn's final reply, sent after ``turn.done`` so a client can settle its streamed text. |
| [`session.info`](#sessioninfo) | What a client shows about a session: model, folder, tools, whether a turn runs. |
| [`session.usage`](#sessionusage) | The session's counters after a turn or on request. |
| [`session.title`](#sessiontitle) | The session's title changed. |
| [`todo.updated`](#todoupdated) | The session's task list changed; the whole list is sent. |
| [`session.viewers`](#sessionviewers) | Who watches the session now (sent whenever a viewer attaches or leaves), so a surface can |
| [`request.settled`](#requestsettled) | An open server request ended; every viewer closes its card. Sent once per request. |
| [`admission.state`](#admissionstate) | An input of the session moved in its queue: queued, started, finished, or lost. |

### turn.started

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | str | yes | The session the event belongs to. |
| `seq` | int | yes | Position in the session's event stream; strictly increasing. |
| `type` | 'turn.started' | no | Event type. |
| `turn_id` | str | yes | The turn's id, as returned by ``prompt.submit``. |
| `generation` | int | yes | The turn's generation; interrupts naming an older one are ignored. |

## Server requests

The host asks the person something through `server_request`; the surface answers with `server_request.answer`.

### approval

Ask whether a risky action (usually a shell command) may run.

Request:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `request_id` | str | yes | Unique id; the answer and any cancellation name it. |
| `session_id` | str | yes | The session asking. |
| `turn_id` | str or null | no | The turn waiting on the answer, if any. |
| `deadline_s` | float or null | no | Seconds the agent waits before withdrawing the request; absent means no deadline. |
| `kind` | 'approval' | no | Request kind. |
| `command` | str | yes | The action to approve, already redacted for display. |
| `description` | str | yes | Why the action needs approval. |
| `choices` | list[ApprovalChoice] | no | The answers the person may pick, in display order; ``deny`` is always allowed. |

Answer:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | 'approval' | no | Answer kind. |
| `choice` | ApprovalChoice | yes | The picked choice. |
| `reason` | str or null | no | Why the person denied, in their words; passed to the model unchanged. |

### clarify

Ask the person one or more questions before the agent goes on.

Request:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `request_id` | str | yes | Unique id; the answer and any cancellation name it. |
| `session_id` | str | yes | The session asking. |
| `turn_id` | str or null | no | The turn waiting on the answer, if any. |
| `deadline_s` | float or null | no | Seconds the agent waits before withdrawing the request; absent means no deadline. |
| `kind` | 'clarify' | no | Request kind. |
| `questions` | list[ClarifyQuestion] | yes | The questions, in display order. |

Answer:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | 'clarify' | no | Answer kind. |
| `answers` | dict[str, list[str]] | yes | Question id → picked choices or typed text; an empty list means the question was skipped. |

### sudo

Ask for the administrator password a command needs.

Request:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `request_id` | str | yes | Unique id; the answer and any cancellation name it. |
| `session_id` | str | yes | The session asking. |
| `turn_id` | str or null | no | The turn waiting on the answer, if any. |
| `deadline_s` | float or null | no | Seconds the agent waits before withdrawing the request; absent means no deadline. |
| `kind` | 'sudo' | no | Request kind. |
| `reason` | str | yes | What the password is for. |

Answer:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | 'sudo' | no | Answer kind. |
| `password` | str or null | no | The password; absent when cancelled. |

### secret

Ask for a secret (an API key or token) to store under a variable name.

Request:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `request_id` | str | yes | Unique id; the answer and any cancellation name it. |
| `session_id` | str | yes | The session asking. |
| `turn_id` | str or null | no | The turn waiting on the answer, if any. |
| `deadline_s` | float or null | no | Seconds the agent waits before withdrawing the request; absent means no deadline. |
| `kind` | 'secret' | no | Request kind. |
| `name` | str | yes | The variable the value is stored as. |
| `prompt` | str | yes | What to tell the person about the secret. |

Answer:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | 'secret' | no | Answer kind. |
| `value` | str or null | no | The value; absent or empty when skipped. |

## Error codes

Each code has one meaning across every method (D-16.27). The group decides the HTTP status a code maps to over HTTP.

| Code | Name | Group | HTTP | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| -32700 | `PARSE_ERROR` | `invalid_request` | 400 | the frame is not valid JSON |
| -32600 | `INVALID_REQUEST` | `invalid_request` | 400 | the JSON value is not a valid request frame |
| -32601 | `METHOD_NOT_FOUND` | `not_found` | 404 | no method with this name is declared |
| -32602 | `INVALID_PARAMS` | `invalid_request` | 400 | the params do not match the method's model (unknown key, wrong type, missing field) |
| -32603 | `INTERNAL_ERROR` | `internal` | 500 | the server failed while handling a valid request |
| 1001 | `TEXT_EMPTY` | `invalid_request` | 400 | the message text is empty or only whitespace |
| 1002 | `UNKNOWN_PARAM_KEY` | `invalid_request` | 400 | the params carry a key the method does not declare (the path names it) |
| 2001 | `SESSION_NOT_FOUND` | `not_found` | 404 | no session has this id |
| 2002 | `SERVER_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND` | `not_found` | 404 | no open server request has this id (never sent, already answered or withdrawn) |
| 2003 | `SLASH_NOT_OWNED` | `not_found` | 404 | the server does not run this slash command; the client handles it, or a later release does |
| 2004 | `UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND` | `not_found` | 404 | the name is not a built-in, quick or skill command |
| 2005 | `ADMISSION_NOT_FOUND` | `not_found` | 404 | no input of this session has this admission id |
| 3001 | `SESSION_BUSY` | `conflict` | 409 | the session is running a turn or is held by another surface |
| 3002 | `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` | `conflict` | 409 | the idempotency key was already used with different parameters |
| 3003 | `ANSWER_KIND_MISMATCH` | `conflict` | 409 | the answer's kind differs from the kind of the server request it answers |
| 3004 | `CONFIRM_REQUIRED` | `conflict` | 409 | the change needs an explicit confirmation; repeat the call with confirm set |
| 3005 | `STALE_GENERATION` | `conflict` | 409 | the call names a turn generation that is not the one it targets now; nothing changed |
| 3006 | `ADMISSION_CONFLICT` | `conflict` | 409 | the input's request id was already used with a different input |
| 3007 | `QUEUE_FULL` | `conflict` | 409 | the session already holds as many queued inputs as it takes; send again once it drains |
| 3008 | `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` | `conflict` | 409 | the turn's outcome is unknown (its daemon stopped or the connection dropped while it ran); it is never run again: do not resend, resolve it with admission.discard |
| 3009 | `POLICY_CONFLICT` | `conflict` | 409 | the launch settings differ from the ones frozen into the session (the fields are named) |
| 3010 | `LEASE_LOST` | `conflict` | 409 | another process took over the session's turn lease; the turn was stopped |
| 4001 | `SESSION_REFUSED` | `refused` | 403 | the session cannot be used: it was deleted or continued in another session |
| 4002 | `SERVER_REQUEST_UNSUPPORTED` | `refused` | 403 | the client cannot answer server requests of this kind |
| 4003 | `SHELL_REFUSED` | `refused` | 403 | the shell command is blocked by the dangerous-command rules and was not run |
| 4005 | `PROFILE_MISMATCH` | `refused` | 403 | the daemon that answered serves another profile; the client stops before sending anything |
| 4401 | `TICKET_INVALID` | `refused` | 403 | the attach ticket is missing, malformed, already used, expired or bound to another purpose |
| 4404 | `NOT_SHOWN` | `refused` | 403 | a viewer does not show this server request here; the other viewers may still answer it |
| 5001 | `PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE` | `provider` | 502 | no usable model provider could be resolved for the session |
| 6001 | `STORE_FAILED` | `internal` | 500 | the session store could not read or write the session |
| 6002 | `SHELL_TIMEOUT` | `internal` | 500 | the shell command did not finish within its time limit and was stopped |
| 6003 | `SLASH_WORKER_FAILED` | `internal` | 500 | the slash command's handler failed or did not answer in time |

Codes that never answer a method call, and where they travel:

| Name | Where |
|---|---|
| `STALE_GENERATION` | a control's answer that nothing changed (the daemon's controls), the reason in admission.discard's result, and product code runtime.stale_generation |
| `PROFILE_MISMATCH` | the client's own refusal of a describe or gateway.ready naming another profile (the WebSocket close code it leaves with), and the control socket's refusal |
| `TICKET_INVALID` | the WebSocket close code of a refused upgrade (missing, used, expired or wrong-purpose ticket) |
| `NOT_SHOWN` | a viewer's error answer to a server request it does not show (only from a viewer that advertised request.decline) |
